```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyquant)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(lattice)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(aod)
```

```{r}
MDGdata <- read_csv("MDGspring20.csv", col_names = TRUE)

demgender <- table(MDGdata$gender)/560
demethnicity <- table(MDGdata$ethnicity)/560
demgender
demethnicity
summary(MDGdata$age)
```

```{r}
learningphase <- MDGdata %>%
  filter(phase<2)

learningphase <- learningphase[c("participant","learningBlock","gTrial","accuracy")]
sapply(learningphase, class)
learningphase$participant<-as.factor(learningphase$participant)
learningphase$learningBlock<-as.factor(learningphase$learningBlock)
sapply(learningphase, class)
```

```{r}
learninganalysis <- glm(accuracy ~ learningBlock + participant, data=learningphase, family = "binomial")
anova(learninganalysis, test='Chisq')
summary(learninganalysis)
```
```{r}
summarylearningdata<-learningphase %>%
  group_by(participant, learningBlock) %>%
  get_summary_stats(accuracy, type = "mean_se")
summarylearningdata

```




```{r}
learningfiguredata <- summarylearningdata %>%
  group_by(learningBlock) %>%
  get_summary_stats(mean, type = "mean_se")
learningfiguredata2 <- learningfiguredata %>%
  mutate(value = mean) %>%
  mutate(whisker = se) 
learningfiguredata2
```

```{r}
learningplot <- ggplot(learningfiguredata2, aes(x=learningBlock,y=value, group=1)) +
  geom_line(position=position_dodge(.9), stat="identity",color="black", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=value-whisker,ymax=value+whisker),width=.5,position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  xlab("Block") +
  ylab("Mean Accuracy") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1, linetype = "solid")) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(text=element_text(family="serif"))


print(learningplot)
```

```{r}
testphase <- MDGdata %>%
  filter(phase>1)

testphase <- testphase[c("participant","block","gTrial","accuracy","totalclick","click1","click2","click3","click4","click1.order","click2.order","click3.order","click4.order","genoutcome")]
sapply(learningphase, class)
testphase$participant<-as.factor(testphase$participant)
testphase$block<-as.factor(testphase$block)
testphase$genoutcome<-as.factor(testphase$genoutcome)

sapply(testphase, class)
```

```{r}
test1analysis <- glm(click1 ~ genoutcome + participant, data=testphase, family = "binomial")
anova(test1analysis, test='Chisq')
summary(test1analysis)
```

```{r}
test2data <- testphase %>%
  mutate(
    genoutcome=ifelse(genoutcome==2,1,ifelse(genoutcome==1,2,genoutcome)))
test2data$genoutcome<-as.factor(test2data$genoutcome)
summary(test2data)
```

```{r}
test2analysis <- glm(click2 ~ genoutcome + participant, data=test2data, family = "binomial")
anova(test2analysis, test='Chisq')
summary(test2analysis)
```

```{r}
test3data <- testphase %>%
  mutate(
    genoutcome=ifelse(genoutcome==3,1,ifelse(genoutcome==1,3,genoutcome)))
test3data$genoutcome<-as.factor(test3data$genoutcome)
summary(test3data)
```
```{r}
test3analysis <- glm(click3 ~ genoutcome + participant, data=test3data, family = "binomial")
anova(test3analysis, test='Chisq')
summary(test3analysis)
```

```{r}
test4data <- testphase %>%
  mutate(
    genoutcome=ifelse(genoutcome==4,1,ifelse(genoutcome==1,4,genoutcome)))
test4data$genoutcome<-as.factor(test4data$genoutcome)
summary(test4data)
```
```{r}
test4analysis <- glm(click4 ~ genoutcome + participant, data=test4data, family = "binomial")
anova(test4analysis, test='Chisq')
summary(test4analysis)
```

```{r}
logitdata <- testphase %>%
  gather(test, click, click1:click4) %>%
  gather(test2, order, click1.order:click4.order)
logitdata$test <- as.factor(logitdata$test)
```


```{r}
selectionanalysis <- glm(click ~ genoutcome*test + participant, data=logitdata, family = "binomial")
anova(selectionanalysis, test='Chisq')
summary(selectionanalysis)
```


```{r}
testsummarydata <- testphase %>%
  gather(test, click, click1:click4) %>%
  gather(test2, order, click1.order:click4.order)
testsummarydata <- testsummarydata %>%
  group_by(participant,genoutcome,test) %>%
  get_summary_stats(click, type="mean_se")
testfiguredata <- testsummarydata %>%
  group_by(genoutcome,test) %>%
  get_summary_stats(mean, type="mean_se")
testfiguredata <- testfiguredata %>%
  mutate(value = mean) %>%
  mutate(whisker = se)
```

```{r}
testplot <- ggplot(testfiguredata, aes(x=genoutcome,y=value,fill=test)) +
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(.9), stat="identity",color="black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=value-whisker,ymax=value+whisker),width=.5,position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Test",values=c("#B3A369","#003057","#FFFFFF","#545454"),labels=c("1","2","3","4")) +
  xlab("Presenting Cue") +
  ylab("Selection") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1, linetype = "solid")) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = c(.5,.9)) +
  theme(legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=12, family="serif"))


print(testplot)
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
diagnosticity <- matrix(c(7.28,6.56,5.84,5.84, 5.84,7.28,6.56,5.84,5.84,5.84,7.28,6.56,6.56,5.84,5.84,7.28), byrow=T,nrow=4,ncol=4)
colnames(diagnosticity) <- c('Test 1', 'Test 2', 'Test 3', 'Test 4')
rownames(diagnosticity) <- c('1', '2', '3', '4')
print(diagnosticity)

longdiag<-melt(diagnosticity)
print(longdiag)
```

```{r}
diagnosticityplot <- ggplot(longdiag, aes(x=Var1,y=value,fill=Var2)) +
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(.9), stat="identity",color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Test",values=c("#B3A369","#003057","#FFFFFF","#545454"),labels=c("1","2","3","4")) +
  xlab("Presenting Cue") +
  ylab("Diagnosticity") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1, linetype = "solid")) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = c(.5,.9)) +
  theme(legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=12, family="serif"))


print(diagnosticityplot)
```
